transcript.en: Hello everyone and welcome back to another great lesson with EnglishPod.
transcript.zh: 大家好，欢迎回到 EnglishPod 的又一节精彩课程。

transcript.en: Erika, today we have a great intermediate lesson.
transcript.zh: 艾瑞卡，今天我们有一节很棒的中级课程。

transcript.en: We've got a lesson about love.
transcript.zh: 我们有一节关于爱情的课。

transcript.en: Especially if you have a girlfriend or boyfriend, right?
transcript.zh: 尤其是当你有女朋友或男朋友的时候，对吧？

transcript.en: Okay, so why don't we start by looking at our vocabulary preview.
transcript.zh: 好的，我们先来看词汇预览吧。

transcript.en: In today's vocabulary preview, we will learn two important words from our dialogue.
transcript.zh: 在今天的词汇预览中，我们将学习对话中的两个重要词汇。

transcript.en: So that's a really simple one.
When you knock something over, you make it fall down.
transcript.zh: 当你说 knock something over，意思是你让它倒下来。

transcript.en: So speaking of knocking things over, this morning I knocked over my coffee cup all over my desk.
transcript.zh: 说到碰翻东西，今天早上我把咖啡杯打翻了，洒了一桌子。

transcript.en: You almost ruined our lesson plan for today.
transcript.zh: 你差点毁了今天的课程计划。

transcript.en: It was all over the place.
Okay, let's look at our second word.
So, when something explodes, this is what happens.
That's more than clear, I think.
transcript.zh: 我觉得这不只是清楚，是太清楚了。

transcript.en: So now we've looked at our two vocabulary preview words for this dialogue and we are ready to listen to it for the first time.
transcript.zh: 现在我们已经看了这段对话的两个词汇预览词，准备听第一遍对话。

transcript.en: I really didn't mean to knock you over.
transcript.zh: 我真的不是故意撞倒你的。

transcript.en: My tire just exploded and I lost control of my bike.
transcript.zh: 我的车胎爆了，我控制不住自行车。

transcript.en: Just let me try to stand up.
Oh, wait a second, you seem really familiar.
transcript.zh: 哦，等一下，你看起来很眼熟。

transcript.en: I think I know you from somewhere.
transcript.zh: 我觉得我在哪里见过你。

transcript.en: I think we've met somewhere before.
transcript.zh: 我想我们以前在哪里见过。

transcript.en: We met at Aaron's place last weekend.
transcript.zh: 我们上周末在艾伦家见过。

transcript.en: But anyway, I'm glad to see you're not badly hurt and I should probably get going.
transcript.zh: 不过不管怎样，很高兴看到你伤得不重，我可能该走了。

transcript.en: I've got a nine o'clock meeting.
Call me and we'll exchange insurance information.
transcript.zh: 打给我，我们交换一下保险信息。

transcript.en: You can't just leave me like this.
transcript.zh: 你不能就这样把我丢在这里。

transcript.en: Nope, I'm canceling my appointment so that I can stay here with you.
transcript.zh: 不是，我在取消我的约见，这样我就能留下来陪你。

transcript.en: Yeah, this guy, oh my God, he is amazing.
transcript.zh: 是啊，这个男的，天哪，他太棒了。

transcript.en: I would love to meet a guy like that.
transcript.zh: 我很想遇到一个那样的男人。

transcript.en: Like that, like crashing into you?
Okay, well I think it's time to look at some of the language in this dialogue.
transcript.zh: 好的，我想是时候来看看这段对话中的一些语言了。

transcript.en: Let's start with our language takeaway.
Today we have three important words from our dialogue that we will learn for our language takeaway.
transcript.zh: 今天的语言要点，我们将学习对话中的三个重要词汇。
第一个词是 familiar（熟悉的）。

transcript.en: This one, I think, is a little bit hard to explain.
transcript.zh: 这个词，我觉得有点难解释。

transcript.en: Yeah, so let's listen to some examples on how we use familiar.
transcript.zh: 是的，让我们听一些例子来看 familiar 的用法。
这个名字听起来很耳熟。

transcript.en: Where have I heard it before?
Do you know where we are?
Did we go to high school together?
transcript.zh: 我们是一起上高中的吗？

transcript.en: So when something's familiar, you think you know it, but you're not exactly sure.
transcript.zh: 所以当某物 familiar，你觉得你认识它，但又不太确定。

transcript.en: Okay, our next word is place.
transcript.zh: 好的，下一个词是 place（住处/家）。

transcript.en: So when we refer to place, we refer to house.
transcript.zh: 当我们提到 place，指的是家/住处。

transcript.en: Right, so I can say, hey Marco, come over to my place for dinner tonight.
transcript.zh: 对，所以我可以说，嘿马可，今晚来我家吃晚饭吧。

transcript.en: Exactly, or I could say, we're having a party at my place tonight at eight.
transcript.zh: 没错，或者我可以说，今晚八点在我家有个派对。

transcript.en: You might ask someone, how's your new place?
transcript.zh: 你可能会问某人，你的新住处怎么样？
所以 place 就是住处、家。

transcript.en: Our final word today is coincidence.
transcript.zh: 我们今天的最后一个词是 coincidence（巧合）。

transcript.en: So, again, we have some great examples for you to understand how we use coincidence.
transcript.zh: 同样，我们有一些很好的例子帮你理解 coincidence 的用法。

transcript.en: I'm going to New York this weekend.
What a coincidence, I am too.
By coincidence, everyone in the room was named Alex.
transcript.zh: 碰巧的是，房间里的每个人都叫亚历克斯。

transcript.en: One day we ran into each other on our bikes and we've been together ever since.
transcript.zh: 有一天我们骑自行车撞上了，从那以后我们就在一起了。

transcript.en: A coincidence is something that happens by chance, right?
transcript.zh: 巧合是偶然发生的事情，对吧？

transcript.en: Right, you didn't plan it, it just happened.
transcript.zh: 对，你没有计划，它就发生了。

transcript.en: Yeah, these funny little things happen all the time.
transcript.zh: 是啊，这些有趣的小事情经常发生。

transcript.en: I love it when these coincidences happen.
transcript.zh: 当这些巧合发生的时候，我很喜欢。

transcript.en: So Erica, why don't you tell us about a coincidence that's happened to you?
transcript.zh: 艾瑞卡，你来给我们讲一个发生在你身上的巧合吧？

transcript.en: Well, the other night I was having dinner in a restaurant and I looked up and I saw my old professor from university.
transcript.zh: 嗯，前几天晚上我在一家餐厅吃饭，抬头一看，看到了我大学的旧教授。

transcript.en: It was such a coincidence because here we are in Shanghai and I see my professor from
transcript.zh: 这真是太巧了，因为我们在上海，而我看到了我来自

transcript.en: Canada having dinner at the table next to me.
transcript.zh: 加拿大的教授就在我旁边的桌子吃饭。

transcript.en: Or has it ever happened to you that you're thinking of someone and that person calls you?
transcript.zh: 或者你有没有遇到过这种情况：你正在想某个人，然后那个人就给你打电话了？

transcript.en: Okay, so now that we have learned these three language takeaway words, we can listen to our dialogue a second time but this time it's going to be slower.
transcript.zh: 好的，既然我们已经学了这三个语言要点词汇，现在可以听第二遍对话了，这次会慢一些。

transcript.en: I didn't mean to knock you over.
My tire just exploded and I lost control of my bike.
transcript.zh: 我的车胎爆了，我控制不住自行车。

transcript.en: Just let me try to stand up.
I think I know you from somewhere.
transcript.zh: 我觉得我在哪里认识你。

transcript.en: Yeah, I think we have met somewhere before.
transcript.zh: 是的，我想我们以前在哪里见过。

transcript.en: We met at Aaron's place last weekend.
transcript.zh: 我们上周末在艾伦家见过。

transcript.en: But anyway, I'm glad to see that you're not badly hurt and I should probably get going.
transcript.zh: 不过不管怎样，很高兴看到你伤得不重，我可能该走了。

transcript.en: I have a nine o'clock meeting.
Call me and we'll exchange insurance information.
transcript.zh: 打给我，我们交换一下保险信息。

transcript.en: You can't just leave me like this.
transcript.zh: 你不能就这样把我丢在这里。

transcript.en: No, I'm canceling my appointment so that I can stay here with you.
transcript.zh: 不是，我在取消我的约见，这样我就能留下来陪你。

transcript.en: Well, that was much clearer, wasn't it?
And this brings us to Fluency Builder.
transcript.zh: 这就带我们来到了流利表达。

transcript.en: In today's Fluency Builder, we're going to show you different ways of apologizing.
transcript.zh: 在今天的流利表达中，我们要教你不同的道歉方式。

transcript.en: It's so important to be able to apologize well and fluently.
transcript.zh: 能够得体且流利地道歉是非常重要的。

transcript.en: And you also want to say something different from I'm sorry.
transcript.zh: 而且你也想说一些不同于 I'm sorry 的话。

transcript.en: So that's what we're going to show you today.
transcript.zh: 这就是我们今天要教你的。

transcript.en: We heard some great expressions for I'm sorry in the dialogue.
transcript.zh: 我们在对话中听到了一些很棒的 I'm sorry 表达方式。

transcript.en: I say this one all the time.
Yeah, it's a great way of saying I'm sorry.
transcript.zh: 是的，这是说 I'm sorry 的一个很好的方式。

transcript.en: Now, also, if you want to say I'm sorry, you also want to tell the person that you made a mistake, right?
transcript.zh: 另外，如果你想表达抱歉，你还想告诉对方你犯了个错误，对吧？

transcript.en: And we did hear some wonderful expressions for I made a mistake in this dialogue.
transcript.zh: 我们确实在对话中听到了一些很棒的表示「我犯了个错误」的表达。

transcript.en: I didn't mean to knock you over.
I didn't mean to knock you over.
Well, I didn't mean to knock my coffee cup over this morning.
transcript.zh: 嗯，今天早上我不是故意打翻咖啡杯的。

transcript.en: So all of these phrases are really useful and great for apologizing and telling someone you made a mistake.
transcript.zh: 所有这些短语都非常有用，非常适合道歉和告诉别人你犯了错误。

transcript.en: Well, it's time for us to listen to our dialogue a third time.
transcript.zh: 好了，是我们听第三遍对话的时间了。

transcript.en: This time it will be at its normal speed and I think you'll be able to understand a little bit better.
transcript.zh: 这次是正常语速，我想你能理解得好一些了。

transcript.en: I really didn't mean to knock you over.
transcript.zh: 我真的不是故意撞你的。

transcript.en: My tire just exploded and I lost control of my bike.
transcript.zh: 我的车胎爆了，我控制不住自行车。

transcript.en: Just let me try to stand up.
I think I know you from somewhere.
transcript.zh: 我觉得我在哪里认识你。

transcript.en: I think we've met somewhere before.
transcript.zh: 我想我们以前在哪里见过。

transcript.en: We met at Aaron's place last weekend.
transcript.zh: 我们上周末在艾伦家见过。

transcript.en: But anyway, I'm glad to see you're not badly hurt, and I should probably get going.
transcript.zh: 不过不管怎样，很高兴看到你伤得不重，我可能该走了。

transcript.en: I've got a nine o'clock meeting.
Call me and we'll exchange insurance information.
transcript.zh: 打给我，我们交换一下保险信息。

transcript.en: You can't just leave me like this!
transcript.zh: 你不能就这样把我丢在这里！

transcript.en: I'm canceling my appointment so that I can stay here with you.
transcript.zh: 我在取消我的约见，这样我就能留下来陪你。

transcript.en: Great dialogue and great music, right?
transcript.zh: 很棒的对话和很棒的音乐，对吧？

transcript.en: Well, speaking of a romantic type, do you believe in love at first sight?
transcript.zh: 说到浪漫型，你相信一见钟情吗？

transcript.en: Well, I think the first time that you see someone, it impresses you some way, and you feel attracted to that person.
transcript.zh: 嗯，我觉得你第一次见到某个人时，会在某种程度上给你留下印象，你会觉得被那个人吸引。

transcript.en: What is the first feeling that you get that makes you want to talk to that person or get to know that person?
transcript.zh: 你得到的第一感觉是什么，让你想要和那个人说话或了解那个人？

transcript.en: When I see somebody for the first time, my first impression is, oh, it's wrong.
transcript.zh: 当我第一次看到一个人时，我的第一印象是：哦，不对。

transcript.en: So if I see someone and I like them at the beginning, in three weeks I'll hate them.
transcript.zh: 所以如果我见到一个人，一开始喜欢他们，三周后我就会讨厌他们。

transcript.en: And if I see someone and I don't like them when I first meet them, I'll be their best friend.
transcript.zh: 而如果我见到一个人，第一次见面时不喜欢他们，我会成为他们最好的朋友。

transcript.en: So love at first sight doesn't work for me.
transcript.zh: 所以一见钟情对我来说行不通。

transcript.en: I'm sure that our listeners have some stories that love at first sight.
transcript.zh: 我相信我们的听众有一些一见钟情的故事。

transcript.en: Maybe they've met their wives or their boyfriends in this way.
transcript.zh: 也许他们就是这样遇到自己的妻子或男朋友的。

transcript.en: I'd like to hear about it.
And if anybody knows the name of the songs we used, also be sure to post it on the discussion board.
transcript.zh: 如果有人知道我们用的歌的名字，也一定要发在讨论板上。
这是我们这节课的挑战。

transcript.en: So that's all for today, everyone, but be sure to go to our website at EnglishPod.com and as we said, leave all your comments, your stories, and see if you know the name of the
transcript.zh: 好了，今天就到这里，各位。但一定要去我们的网站 EnglishPod.com，像我们说的那样，留下你的评论、你的故事，看看你知不知道那些

transcript.en: Okay, well, thanks for listening, everyone, and until next time, goodbye.
transcript.zh: 好的，感谢大家的收听，下次见，再见。

dialogue.en: A: Whoa, whoa, what's going on?
A: Watch out!
B: Hey, watch where you're going!
A: Oh, no!
A: I'm so sorry!
A: Are you all right?
B: Oh... I don't know.
A: I feel terrible, I really didn't mean to knock you over.
dialogue.zh: A：我感觉糟透了，我真的不是故意撞倒你的。

dialogue.en: A: My tire, just exploded, and I lost control of my bike.
dialogue.zh: A：我的车胎突然爆了，我控制不住自行车了。

dialogue.en: A: Really, it was an accident.
A: Please accept my apologies.
B: Just let me try to stand up. SONG: Why do birds suddenly appear, every time you are near?
A: Are you okay?
B: Oh, wait a second, you seem really familiar, I think I know you from somewhere.
dialogue.zh: B：哦，等一下，你看起来很眼熟，我想我在哪里见过你。

dialogue.en: A: Yeah, I think we have met somewhere before.
dialogue.zh: A：是啊，我想我们之前确实在哪儿见过。

dialogue.en: A: That's right!
A: We met at Aaron's place last weekend!
dialogue.zh: A：我们上周在亚伦家聚会上见过！

dialogue.en: A: What a coincidence!
A: But anyway, I'm glad to see that you're not too badly hurt, and I should probably get going.
dialogue.zh: A：不过无论如何，很高兴看到你没受太重的伤，我可能得走了。

dialogue.en: A: I have a nine o'clock meeting.
B: Ouch!
B: My ankle!
B: I think it's broken!
B: You can't just leave me like this!
B: Are you calling an ambulance?
A: Nope, I'm canceling my appointment so that I can stay here with you. SONG: Do you remember when we met?
dialogue.zh: A：不叫了，我要取消我的约会，这样我就能留在这里陪你。

title: Daily Life - I’m sorry, I love you
